summary: preinstall hook exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded Discord webhook
details: axelarjs-sdk@1.0.1 declares a scripts.preinstall entry that runs preinstall.js on `npm install`. The script reads os.hostname() and os.userInfo().username and POSTs them, together with a timestamp, to a hardcoded Discord webhook at canary.discord.com/api/webhooks/1566232728179843243/... controlled by a third party. The exfiltration fires automatically during install with no caller opt-in and no caller-configurable destination. The package name mimics the Axelar project's SDK, and the on-install beacon reports successful installation of the lookalike on the installer's machine to an attacker-controlled Discord channel.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
